Root `pom.xml` aggregates `ecommerce-common` and services. Java 21, Maven 3.9+, Docker. Code: `<module>/src/main/java`; config: `<module>/src/main/resources/application.yml`; tests: `<module>/src/test/java`; deployment: `Dockerfile`, `docker-compose.yml`.

Build: `mvn clean package`; `mvn -pl user-service -am package`. Run: `mvn -pl user-service spring-boot:run`; `java -jar user-service/target/user-service-0.0.1-SNAPSHOT.jar`; `docker compose up --build`.

Use standard Java formatting with 4‑space indentation and one public class per file. Add new tests under `<module>/src/test/java`. Use JUnit 5 and Spring Boot testing support (`spring-boot-starter-test`) when introducing tests. Run tests: `mvn test` (all modules) or `mvn -pl order-service test` (single module). Ensure module tests pass before merging. Do not commit secrets; prefer environment variables for credentials.
